source.name: GOAL: DR Congo FIFA World Cup 2026 kits: Home, away, release dates & prices
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press World Cup kit write-up: the home shirt carries the FECOFA crest over the heart, the national flag beneath the neckline and Umbro's double-diamond logo on the right chest; no commercial sponsor on any placement, and the strip is completed with matching light blue shorts and socks. FootyLogos' DR Congo 2026 World Cup page (kits/dr-congo-2026-world-cup) likewise lists Umbro as supplier and describes only the crest, flag and Umbro branding on the chest. Football Shirt Culture (20 Dec 2025) described the same light-blue design with tonal lower-half graphic and red trim at its AFCON 2025 launch — one Umbro kit worn at both tournaments.
source.quote: the national flag is centred directly beneath the neckline, balanced by Umbro's double-diamond logo on the right chest

summary: Umbro home kit for DR Congo's 2025 AFCON and 2026 World Cup campaigns — one design, launched December 2025 and worn at the 2026 World Cup. No commercial shirt sponsors: GOAL's World Cup 2026 kit write-up lists only the FECOFA crest, the national flag and Umbro branding on the chest, with matching sponsor-free shorts and socks, and FootyLogos' World Cup kit page shows no commercial sponsor either.
